patterns.note: Content is presented in full-width sections, with primary content constrained to a central, readable column, often utilizing a grid for features, community highlights, and examples.
Prominent, bold sans-serif headings are used for section titles, while code blocks with a distinct monospace font are integrated as key visual and informational elements, particularly in the hero.
A deep, dark teal/green serves as the dominant background for most content sections and the footer, providing a strong contrast to the vibrant, multi-color gradient background of the hero section.

The header navigation sticks to the top of the viewport and transforms its appearance (background color and button style) after a short scroll depth. The hero background illustration exhibits a subtle parallax effect, moving slower than the foreground content.
Sections are clearly delineated by solid background colors, alternating between the vibrant hero gradient and the consistent dark teal/green for subsequent content blocks.

technique_notes: The main navigation bar is implemented as a sticky element that changes its visual state (background transparency, button fill) once the user scrolls past the initial hero section. The hero section features a background illustration that moves at a slower rate than the foreground content, creating a subtle parallax depth effect. Content sections are revealed by simply scrolling into the viewport, without individual element animations.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings for the hero and main sections, with standard body text and distinct monospace for code examples.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on buttons, cards, and the code block, with sharp corners for most other elements.
design_tokens.spacing: The hero section is airy, providing ample breathing room, while subsequent content sections utilize a balanced grid density for features and examples, and the footer is also airy.

standout: The site distinctively integrates a prominent, interactive-looking code block directly into its hero section, immediately communicating its technical nature. This is paired with a vibrant, illustrated background that adds a modern, engaging aesthetic, setting it apart from typical SaaS landing pages.
